claim: Acknowledged journal prefix remains consistent under bounded interruption and injected write/flush/fsync failures.
fixed_cases: successful subsequent append and final checkpoint
interrupt after durable append before checkpoint

controls.positive: Unmodified successful prefix must be accepted by independent reader.
controls.negative: Alter one acknowledged byte and one pointer count in separate fixtures; each must be rejected.
controls.AA: Repeat deterministic successful fixture in fresh directory; exact logical records must match.
controls.baseline: Existing reviewed reader fixture semantics; no timing comparison.

acceptance: Each retained checkpoint authenticates only a durable acknowledged prefix; failed mutation remains failed, incomplete or rejected, never passed. No silent journal truncation or resume. Inspect child exit and owned cleanup for every interruption.
pending_before_execution: Implement bounded harness without importing top-level producer execution; preserve source fidelity of extracted functions.
Independently review harness, case expectations and exact command; freeze experiment.protocol/v1 and analysis bindings if required by checker.
Publish source/protocol/harness and retain GitHub readback.
Root release with current lease, campaign debit/reservation and no-overlap readback.
